game.title: Split/Second
game.blurb: Arcade racing game from Black Rock Studio (RAWG also lists Disney Interactive Studios), published by Disney Interactive, released 2010-05-18. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, Racing, Arcade. Chapters follow the modes the trophies on RAWG show: the Season Championship, its event types, Bonus Rounds, Power Plays and online play.

chapters.title: Season Championship
chapters.summary: Qualifying, winning rounds, reaching round six and finishing the Season Championship, then first place in every event.

chapters.title: Season Event Types
chapters.summary: First wins in Race, Elimination, Detonator, Survival, Air Strike and Air Revenge events, and two Detonator time targets.

chapters.title: Bonus Rounds
chapters.summary: Winning your first, six, and then every Bonus Round.

chapters.title: Power Plays and Driving
chapters.summary: Level 1 and Level 2 Power Plays, route changers, wrecking rivals, distance driven and time in the air.

chapters.title: Online Form
chapters.summary: Online event wins and online form goals. Needs a network connection, if the servers still run.
